lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I wasn't looking.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: But you shot her too. Brendan, did you shoot her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You sure? I think you did.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I never touched the gun.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The first time you told us ah 10 times, about 10 times, that you shot her. And you told us where he shot her. Were you lying then or are you lying now?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I was lying ah then.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Why? Why are there 10 shell casings or more on that garage floor?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well there's gun shells all over the place though.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Were there gun ca-shell casings before you took her in there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don't know. I never seen none.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What kind of gun was it?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And whose gun was it? Was it your gun?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Whose gun was it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The owner of the house's.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And whose trailer was it in?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The one where Steven was living at.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And, where in that trailer was the gun?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: In the bedroom.
